_comment: AX4/AX7 (spec-v2/13-accessibility.md, Wave X step X.5): aria-hidden sites in packages/rendering runtime src. Allowed kinds: overlay layer (AX7), focus sink, or a justified decorative marker/icon whose accessible name lives on a parent or sibling. Each entry needs file, line, and a reason. Remove an entry in the same PR that deletes the attribute.

entries.reason: Focus sink — hide() applies aria-hidden while the sink is not holding a block/cell selection.
Focus sink — reveal() removes aria-hidden when the sink legitimately holds selection focus.
